note: The maker's laminated folios that stand near lore.land (book/scripts/home/worktable.mjs). They live at spwashi.com, where they were made: lore.land points at them and never copies or reprices them (spwashi.com .spw/surfaces/folio-archive.spw — lore.land is a second source for new pieces, never the origin of the archive). Hand-chosen from spwashi.com public/data/folio-days.json; ids are the archive's source ids. 'asks' is the folio's own question where the archive gives one; 'near' is where in lore.land it stands, loosely — a folio is not an episode. Pieces whose title or image names the figure under the hat are left on the maker's side.
